title: AI CO-PILOT RECIPE: HOW TO USE POSTERMAKER

sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI is blind unless guided. **Always verify:** The agent must read `DESIGN.md` before coding. **The Death Loop:** If the AI keeps breaking the design, stop. Force it to run `impeccable teach` and reload the context.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**The Global View:** A code-driven factory for generating high-craft, professional posters.
**The Motivation:** Stop tweaking pixels in Figma. Define content in JSON, let the agent apply the `Typst` visual engine.
**Why skip it?** If you just need a basic Google Doc.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- `typst` CLI installed
- The `data/` and `assets/` folders populated
**Safe Credentials:** No API keys required. It runs 100% locally.
**Accelerants:** Impeccable Design Workflow scripts.

steps.title: Strategic Content Definition
steps.desc: Start by defining your poster content in the `data/` directory. Use `idea/variations.md` for inspiration on different technical contexts.
steps.prompt: Draft a Variant A JSON for data analysis based on the structure in template.md.
steps.result: A structured JSON file mapped to the 3-column grid.
steps.failure: The AI breaks JSON syntax or hallucinates non-existent fields.
steps.fix: Provide the exact JSON schema from `template.md` to the agent.

steps.title: Visual Engine Execution
steps.desc: Switch the data source in `main.typ` and tweak the design tokens in `template.typ` to match your desired aesthetic.
steps.prompt: Change main.typ to use my new json and update the primary color to a warm slate.
steps.result: The local PDF/PNG reflects the new content with cohesive styling.
steps.failure: The layout overflows because of excessively long text strings.
steps.fix: Use Typst grid spanning or reduce font size for specific sections.

steps.title: Quality Assurance & Rendering
steps.desc: Compile the poster and inspect the visual hierarchy. Check for contrast issues and font rendering errors.
steps.prompt: Run typst compile main.typ and check for any font warnings or layout shifts.
steps.result: A high-resolution, print-ready vector file with zero compilation warnings.
steps.failure: Font warnings appear because a variable font is used where a static one is required.
steps.fix: Specify the static font weight (e.g., 'DejaVu Sans' instead of 'DejaVu Sans Variable').

steps.title: AI Context Synchronization
steps.desc: Execute the automation bridge to ensure other AI agents can discover and understand your new poster.
steps.prompt: Run bash scripts/update_llms.sh and verify the available posters list in llms.txt.
steps.result: The `llms.txt` manifest is updated with the new poster title and file path.

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Never hardcode content in `.typ` files. The 'Factory' must remain generic. Always verify your changes with `typst compile main.typ` to ensure the vector logic holds.

steps.title: Visual Contrast Failure
steps.desc: Box titles were unreadable due to low contrast between text and header background.
steps.failure: Dark gray text (#3F443E) on dark primary background.
steps.fix: Updated `template.typ` to use Off-White (#FAF9F5) for all section titles.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Explore `assets/themes/` to implement dynamic theme loading.
**Links:** Official repo at `github.com/abuhafi/posterMaker`.
